meta.title: 数字化转型第一步：先了解业务
meta.title_en: The First Step of Digital Transformation: Understand the Business

scenes.title_cn: 别当救世主：互联网只是工具
scenes.title_en: Don't play the savior: the internet is just a tool
scenes.context: 讲者给出第二个忠告：从互联网公司跳去传统企业，别把自己当救世主，高高在上一定会后悔。互联网只是工具，业务才是主角。
sentences: “我是互联网公司出来的，你们传统企业懂个屁？” 像个救世主一样跑过去，你一定会后悔。
“I'm from an internet company—what do you traditional firms even know?” Swoop in like a messiah and you'll live to regret it.
救世主一样跑过去：swoop in like a messiah
互联网只是工具，是辅助地位，主要地位其实是业务。
The internet is just a tool—it plays a supporting role, while the business is what really matters.
主要地位：what really matters
传统企业这个生意早就能做了，人家做得好好的，甚至还在盈利。
Traditional companies have been running their businesses all along, doing it well and even turning a profit.
做得好好的：have been doing it just fine
paraphrase: 互联网出身 → 自认高人一等
Being from the internet makes you feel superior.
救世主心态 → 必然碰壁
A savior mindset is a one-way ticket to failure.
scenes.speak: “I'm from an internet company—what do you traditional firms even know?” Swoop in like a messiah and you'll live to regret it. After all, the internet is just a tool, playing a supporting role, while the business is what really matters. And traditional companies have been running their businesses all along, doing it well and even turning a profit.

scenes.title_cn: 低调一点：先去了解业务
scenes.title_en: Keep a low profile and understand the business first
scenes.context: 讲者劝大家放低姿态，先花时间下工厂、下门店、跟各业务深入交流，这才是数字化转型的第一步。
sentences: 所以不要觉得自己是互联网人就太高傲了，低调一点。
So don't act too proud just because you're from the internet industry—keep a low profile.
低调一点：keep a low profile
去了以后先花时间了解业务，下工厂、下门店，把情况搞清楚。
Once you're there, spend your time understanding the business first—visit the factories and the stores to get the real picture.
下工厂、下门店：visit the factories and the stores
跟各个业务做深入的交流，这是数字化转型的第一步。
Have in-depth conversations with each business unit—that's the first step of digital transformation.
数字化转型：digital transformation
paraphrase: 放低姿态 → 先当学生
Keep your head down and learn first.
纸上谈兵 → 实地调研
Skip the theory and go see the ground truth.
scenes.speak: So don't act too proud just because you're from the internet industry—keep a low profile. Once you're there, spend your time understanding the business first: visit the factories and the stores to get the real picture. And have in-depth conversations with each business unit—that's the first step of digital transformation.

scenes.title_cn: 别急着搞数据建设：数据不对全是白搭
scenes.title_en: Don't rush into data projects on broken data
scenes.context: 很多人一上来就搞数据建设、催各部门交数据，可数据源本来就是错的；不了解业务，到头来每天被骂、直接走人。
sentences: 很多人飘在天上，一上来就搞数据建设、要求各部门提供数据——人家数据建设那么好的话，还搞什么数字化转型？
Many people get carried away and jump straight into data projects, demanding data from every department—if their data were already that good, why would they need digital transformation at all?
飘在天上：get carried away
你以为分析分析、报个大屏给别人看就行了？老板天天说这数据不对。
You think a few analyses and a fancy dashboard shown to the boss will do? He'll tell you every day that the data is wrong.
报个大屏：show off a fancy dashboard
因为你根本不了解业务情况、不了解人性。
Because you have no real understanding of the business—or of human nature.
人性：human nature
paraphrase: 先要数据 → 数据本身就是错的
Demanding data is pointless when the data is broken.
不了解业务 → 每天被骂走人
Without business knowledge, you'll be blamed out the door.
scenes.speak: Too many people get carried away and jump straight into data projects, demanding data from every department. But if their data were already that good, why would they need digital transformation at all? You think a few analyses and a fancy dashboard shown to the boss will do? He'll tell you every day that the data is wrong. Because you have no real understanding of the business—or of human nature.

practice: Don't swoop in like a messiah—you'll regret it.
The internet is just a tool; the business is what really matters.
Keep a low profile and learn the business first.
The data is wrong from the source, so all the analytics are pointless.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Don't be too tall and above.
✓ 地道说法：Don't act high and mighty / keep a low profile.
「高高在上」不能直译成 tall，英语惯用 high and mighty。
✕ 直译腔：The internet is the supporting position.
✓ 地道说法：The internet is just a tool—a supporting role.
中文「地位」不能直译成 position，用 role 更自然。
✕ 直译腔：Down to the factory, down to the store.
✓ 地道说法：Get out to the factories and the stores.
「下工厂、下门店」是去现场调研，用 get out to / hit the stores。
✕ 直译腔：Report a big screen to others.
✓ 地道说法：Show off a dashboard.
「报个大屏」直译很怪，dashboard 是数据圈地道说法。
shifts: 从互联网去传统企业，觉得「我是来改造你们的」
「互联网只是工具，业务才是主体」
一上来就搞数据建设、向各部门要数据
先花时间了解业务，再谈数据和系统
把数字化转型当成「上线系统」
把数字化转型当成「先了解业务、再等时机」
